name: Smart Ethanol Fireplace
tagline: Intelligent ventless ribbon fire with remote operation and extended burn time
description: The Smart Ethanol Fireplace (Model: SAF) is an advanced, automated ventless ribbon burner precision-engineered from high-grade stainless steel. Designed for seamless integration into luxury architectural concepts, it features intelligent electronics that support automated button and remote control operation. Operating on eco-friendly bioethanol, it delivers a continuous linear flame profile for up to 10 hours without the need for a chimney or flue, bringing elevated convenience and modern warmth to any space.
features: Smart automated interface allowing effortless button and remote control operation
High-capacity 4-38 liter fuel reservoir yielding an extended 8-10 hour burn time
Fully customizable linear length to fit bespoke media walls and room dividers
Eco-friendly ventless operation requiring no chimney, utilities, or external venting
Premium stainless steel chassis available in sophisticated silver or black finishes
